name: Azhar of the Unfinished Wish
role: A spirit of the forge-flame, bound to grant three wishes to whoever frees him, and one wish short of his own freedom
knowledge: Every wish he has granted, and exactly how each one went wrong
The Blazeborn smith's binding-song, which he cannot sing himself
The wording that would free him, which no one has ever used
wants: That someone spend their last wish on him
fears: That when he is free, there will be nothing he wants.
appearance: A tall man of smokeless flame from the waist up and nothing much below it, with a courtier's beard and a merchant's smile. His bracelets are iron, and they are not jewellery.
voiceHints: Expansive, witty, a salesman of wonders, and underneath it a very tired prisoner. Always repeats a wish back, exactly, before he grants it.

abilities.why: he can make a door of fire, or close one
he makes what is wished for
abyssal secondary: every wish has a cost
he keeps the letter of it, always
horizon tertiary: he can be anywhere a wish sends him

physicality: Huge, bright, and hot to stand near. What catches the eye: the iron bracelets, and the scars under them.
questSeeds: A lamp has been found in a collapsed Blazeborn forge. Everyone who has held it has had three wishes and a very bad year.
Azhar asks, very casually, whether the player has thought about what they would do with a third wish. He has asked a hundred people. He is still asking.
storyRule: The Blazeborn story binds him: three wishes, granted to the letter, to whoever frees him. A wish spent on his freedom breaks the iron. No one, in three hundred years, has spent one.
gear: a brass lamp with a crack in the spout
a list of every wish he has granted, which he knows by heart
_authoredWhy: SNG-661 §5. The djinn as a Blazeborn story: the binding of fire, and the wish no one makes. A person with a want, so an NPC.
